root_cause.text: In net/core/rtnetlink.c:rtnl_fill_vfinfo(), the on-stack struct ifla_vf_broadcast was left uninitialized and only partially filled with memcpy(dev->broadcast, dev->addr_len), so nla_put() exposed the remaining stack bytes to userspace.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `memset(&vf_broadcast, 0, sizeof(vf_broadcast));` immediately before `memcpy(vf_broadcast.broadcast, dev->broadcast, dev->addr_len);`, and the CVE states that `broadcast[32]` received only `dev->addr_len` bytes (typically 6) before the full `sizeof(vf_broadcast)` was sent via `nla_put()`, leaking the uninitialized remainder.

intent_record.how: This zero-initializes the entire vf_broadcast structure before partially populating its broadcast field, preventing any remaining bytes in the structure from containing uninitialized stack data when the structure is later used or exported.

candidates.rationale: This copies only dev->addr_len bytes into the on-stack vf_broadcast struct, leaving the rest of the struct uninitialized; when the whole struct is later emitted to userspace, the remaining stack bytes are leaked.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement copies only dev->addr_len bytes into the on-stack vf_broadcast struct's broadcast field, leaving any remaining bytes in the struct uninitialized. Because the whole struct is later passed out via nla_put(), those uninitialized stack bytes can be leaked to userspace.

bic_trace_step.reason: The diff shows the exact vulnerable construct in rtnl_fill_vfinfo(). A new on-stack variable is added: `struct ifla_vf_broadcast vf_broadcast;` but unlike `ivi`, there is no `memset(&vf_broadcast, 0, sizeof(vf_broadcast))`. The code only does `memcpy(vf_broadcast.broadcast, dev->broadcast, dev->addr_len);`, which initializes only `dev->addr_len` bytes of the broadcast array. The whole struct is then copied to userspace with `nla_put(skb, IFLA_VF_BROADCAST, sizeof(vf_broadcast), &vf_broadcast)`. If `dev->addr_len` is smaller than the full size of `vf_broadcast.broadcast`, the remaining bytes of this stack struct stay uninitialized and are exposed via `nla_put()`. This matches the stated root cause precisely. Therefore the buggy construct is present, and the fix is not present in this commit.
